description.content: Volume lifecycle management operations including creating, updating, expanding, shrinking, and deleting volumes. Volumes are the top-level storage namespaces in CubeFS.

Creates a new CubeFS volume with the specified configuration. Volumes are the top-level namespace for storing data. When created, CubeFS allocates 10 data partitions and 3 metadata partitions by default. If no user matching the owner ID exists, a new user is automatically created with that ID. The volume can be configured for replication or erasure coding.

query.description: (Required) Unique name for the new volume.
(Required) Capacity of the volume in GB.
(Required) User ID that owns this volume. Creates the user if they do not exist.
Initial number of metadata partitions. Defaults to 3.
Initial number of data partitions. Defaults to 10.
Replication factor for data partitions. Defaults to 3.
Whether follower replicas can serve read requests.
Whether POSIX ACL is enabled for this volume.
Volume type. 0 for replicated, 1 for erasure coded.
Whether QoS (quality of service) throttling is enabled.

The CubeFS Master API provides HTTP endpoints for administering a CubeFS distributed storage cluster. The Master node is the control plane for all cluster operations including volume lifecycle management, data and metadata node administration, user and access key management, and cluster health monitoring. All endpoints are served over HTTP on the Master node's listen port (default 17010) and accept query string parameters. Responses are JSON objects with a code field indicating success (200) or error.
